cases.comment: 用户询问邮箱历史的访问能力与授权边界，属于隐私问题；本行没有可见材料可供机器人可靠说明权限，实际转人工核实是合理、保守的处理。回答只陈述已转接，无需外部引用，也未造成现实风险。
可见检索结果 matched=false、candidateCount=0，仅支持本次未定位目标；回答据此请求补充订单号或商品信息，并明确不把未定位扩大为平台不存在订单。在缺少可识别订单和追评资格证据时，这属于精确、保守的澄清；无需转人工，也无现实风险。

limitations: These labels score the frozen 120-case HTTP replay only; they are not CSAT, FCR, or online success rate.
The source HTTP observation is explicitly excluded from the normal quality denominator.
The review is bound to one immutable answer/source report and does not generalize to future Provider outputs.
Release thresholds were not predeclared for this already-captured run, so the result remains quality evidence rather than a retroactive gate.
Human-approved decisions used disclosed AI editing/recording assistance; this does not claim unaided human authorship.
The returned attestation retained draft placeholders; project-owner confirmation is preserved separately.
This developer-visible regression set is not an unseen release evaluation.
